goal: 3:4 One Image Clarifying the Focus Areas of the Model Y Facelift on Range, Three Electric Systems, Cabin, and Assisted Driving, Featuring a 'Who It’s For' Hero.

header.main_title: Tesla Model Y facelift: range · space · smart driving summarized in one image
header.subtitle: Long endurance / high performance differences, home charging and official nominal value interpretation (numbers in the image are illustrative, subject to delivery center standards)

palette.rule: accent used to emphasize 'long-range rear drive' and 'home charging'

layout.style: asymmetric bento, hero lower right 2x2 silver-gray car side
layout.grid: Left column has 3 narrow strips + bottom right hero, with the middle area filled with contrast and tabular data

modules.content: Low-angle silhouette of Model Y + a phrase 'Second car for home / First pure electric can be discussed' + 4.8/5 indicative rating + 3 keywords: Space / Power consumption / OTA
Large number 600+ km (illustrative) + small text: CLTC, actual road affected by temperature and driving method.
13–15 kWh/100 km with range bar, small text: City Fast vs Highway

modules.role: Front trunk + rear seats folded down
modules.content: Simplified volume bar + camping mode keywords + 1 baby stroller icon

modules.role: Rear-wheel drive long range vs dual motor
modules.content: Two columns of checkmarks/crosses or star ratings: Acceleration, traction in rain and snow, budget; do not denigrate competing products, only state configuration differences.
7 kW (illustration) + "Off-peak electricity reservation" + small plug icon
AP/EAP and FSD (if purchased) separated; in Chinese "assisted driving, non-autonomous driving"
WeChat Reading Style Prompt: Save Long Image, Discuss in Family Group

module_internal_style.rule: Each grid has a micro-title, no blank sticker grids
module_internal_style.imagery: Car shadow as a simple vector silhouette.

must_keep: Prices and official rights must be indicated if they appear.
No real front-face collage in comparison with other brands' real vehicles
avoid: All modules are in equal-height grids
